summary.text: Eric Roberts is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 83 since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Eric Roberts earned a degree from Southern Methodist University, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning and operating Colonial Center LP.
Ballotpedia says he serves on the board of Ozarks Team Challenge.
He took office on November 18, 2020, succeeding Chelsey Branham, and Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Government Oversight Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Dalton Gau as also running in the November 3, 2026 general election for District 83.
